mission.title: Sharing Supersnack!
mission.subtitle: Let's explore fractions by sharing equally.

rail.title: Fraction Rescue
rail.blurb: Help the crew share the supplies equally!

model.title: 1 Whole Space Chocolate Bar
model.caption: Six chocolate pieces will be shared equally.
model.alt: A chocolate bar divided into six equal sections

prompt.statement: Three astronauts share six chocolate pieces equally.
prompt.question:
How many pieces
does each get?

think_about.text: If something is shared equally, each person gets the same amount.

hints: Count the six equal chocolate pieces.
Share the pieces one at a time among three astronauts.
Each astronaut gets two chocolate pieces.

easier.statement: Two astronauts share six chocolate pieces equally.
easier.label: Sharing between 2

nova.speech: Let's share the chocolate pieces equally! Count carefully. 👀
nova.voice: Let's count the chocolate pieces and share them fairly.

questions.title: Pick Any 4!
questions.instruction:
Look at the chocolate bar.
Choose the four true statements.

models.label: Chocolate bar
models.alt: A chocolate bar divided into six equal sections
hints: Count the spaces in the chocolate bar.
Compare the width and height of each section.
The bar has two columns and three rows.
models.feedback_wrong: Look again: count the sections, columns, and rows, then compare their sizes. 🔍

questions.feedback_correct: Great work! You found all four true facts about the chocolate bar. ✦

nova.voice: Look at the chocolate bar and choose the four true statements.

questions.title: True or False?
questions.instruction:
Look at the pizza.
It is divided into four equal parts.

models.label: Equal pizza
models.alt: A pizza divided into four equal slices
hints: Count the pizza slices.
Compare each slice from the centre to the crust.
All four slices have the same size.
models.feedback_wrong: Compare the four slices again. Each one has the same shape and size. 🔍

questions.feedback_correct: Correct! The whole pizza is split into four equal parts. ✦

nova.voice: Is this pizza divided into four equal parts?

questions.title: Spot the Mistake!
questions.instruction:
Look carefully.
Are all four pizza slices equal-sized?

models.label: Unequal pizza
models.alt: A pizza cut into four slices of different sizes
hints: Compare the spaces between each cut.
Look at the slice on the upper right.
One slice is much smaller than the others.
models.feedback_wrong: Look at the upper-right slice. It is smaller than the other pieces. 🔍

questions.feedback_correct: Correct! These slices are not all the same size. ✦

nova.voice: Are all four pizza slices equal-sized?

questions.title: Choose the Fraction!
questions.instruction:
Three of four equal pizza parts remain.
What fraction of the pizza is shown?

models.label: Three-quarter pizza
models.alt: Three out of four equal pizza quarters
hints: Count all four equal spaces.
Count the three pizza parts that are present.
Three out of four is written as 3/4.
models.feedback_wrong: Count the three pizza pieces out of four equal spaces. 🔍

questions.feedback_correct: Exactly! Three of the four equal parts are shown: 3/4. ✦

nova.speech: Count the shown parts and all the spaces! 🔍
nova.voice: What fraction of the pizza is shown?

questions.title: Find the Half!
questions.instruction:
Look at the shaded pizza pieces.
What fraction of the whole is shaded?

models.label: Half pizza
models.alt: Two shaded quarters of a pizza
hints: The whole has four equal spaces.
Two of the four quarters are shaded.
Two quarters make one half.
models.feedback_wrong: Count two shaded pieces out of four equal pieces, then simplify. 🔍

questions.feedback_correct: Well done! Two out of four equal parts is one half. ✦

nova.speech: Two quarters can make a simpler fraction! 🔍
nova.voice: What fraction of the pizza is shaded?

questions.title: Count Equal Parts!
questions.instruction:
This whole pizza is shared equally.
How many equal parts are there?

models.label: Four-slice pizza
models.alt: A whole pizza separated into four equal slices
hints: Start at the top and count each slice.
Every slice reaches from the centre to the crust.
There are four equal slices.
models.feedback_wrong: Point to each separate slice and count once around the pizza. 🔍

questions.feedback_correct: Correct! The whole pizza has four equal parts. ✦

nova.voice: How many equal parts are in this whole pizza?

nova.speech: Awesome work, {name}! You're building real skills! 🌟

outcomes.heading: You understood
outcomes.description: You can identify and understand equal parts with confidence.

outcomes.heading: You improved
outcomes.description: You're getting better at representing fractions visually.

outcomes.description: Ready to apply your skills to real-world word problems?
